name: LoCMore
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from 89 North (Patchogue) - music calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Clearly a real local country act with repeat bookings at Long Island country nights (89 North, Daisy's), but I found no website, Facebook, Instagram or booking page of its own; venue pages never link one. Spelling varies: LoCMore / LOCMORE / Locmore / Locmore Trio. Worth noting for dancers: the 89 North 'Country Wednesday' nights include line dance lessons. No logo or photos (only venue flyers exist).
description: A Long Island country band (sometimes billed as the Locmore Trio) that plays country dance nights at 89 North in Patchogue and Daisy's Nashville Lounge in Patchogue and Miller Place.

evidence.note: 89 North ticket page: 'Country Wednesday with LoCMore', Wed Oct 14, 2026, doors 6 PM, 21+, tickets at the door; every Wednesday has line dance lessons and a country DJ until 10:30.
Earlier 'Country Wednesdays - Featuring LoCMore' at 89 North, Patchogue (Jan 29, 2025), so this is a repeat booking.
Daisy's (country bar) 'Country Club Fridays with LOCMORE' (May 3, 2024); other Daisy's pages list Locmore at the Miller Place (Nov 2024) and Patchogue (Feb 2025) locations.
Listing for 'Locmore Trio' at Daisy's Nashville Lounge, 22 West Main St, Patchogue, Fri May 29, 2026, 7 PM.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: booketing.com, liblogger.com, daisysli.com, happeningnext.com.
